notes.title: Bugfixes and Demo Availability Extension
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and thanks for checking out the [i]BIRDCAGE -Halcyon Prototype Module-[/i] demo!

We've just updated the game, fixing a few small bugs and tightening up the experience.
The main updates include:
[list]
[*]Fixed a game crashing bug when destroying the enemies in the tutorial using the Sword.
[*]Improved loading at the beginning of stages.
[*]Corrected an issue with the boss destruction sequence.
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] The demo for BIRDCAGE will remain available to play for another week, until [b]October 11th 2023[/b].

Thank you again for your feedback, support, and for playing BIRDCAGE!
Best,
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43159211/87056d1cb96379e98332473904d1135a6ba7fdc7.png[/img]
